name: Burgie's Cozy Kitchen: Halloween Cosmetics Pack
summary:
This DLC contains the following Halloween themed cosmetic changes. You can activate them at any time depending on your mood.

New kitchen decoration.
A darker and more sinister outdoor environment.
Two new spooky customers with their own custom toothpicks.
3 songs with a cozy yet dark vibe.
